messages:
nora: deploy-bot set the release-candidate promotion to HOLD. artifact index manifest sequence mismatch for sdk/connector-5.0.0.tar.gz. deploy-bot: "manifest.seq check failed: registry_seq=4123 index_seq=4119 (delta=4)". this looks like an indexing lag, blocking promotion. thoughts?

owen: I see the indexer logs: a backfill job stalled last night for ~6m, and index_seq stopped advancing for a window. registry shows latest object with seq=4123. indexer resumed but some manifests didn't reconcile.

priya: smoke tests failing with "manifest not found" when the verifier queries index for seq 4123. CI checks rely on index->registry mapping; mismatch fails artifact-verify.

quinn: options: (A) pin to last-indexed artifact (index_seq=4119) to unblock, (B) wait for indexer reconciliation (unknown ETA ~15-30m), or (C) re-run indexer reconcile job immediately. Given change window, (A) seems lowest risk.

nora: agree pin to last-indexed (4119) to keep release schedule. also open INF-3501 to force immediate full reindex + root cause (why backfill stalled).

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_HOLD: reason=manifest-index-drift, candidate_seq=4123, last_indexed_seq=4119, triggered_by=artifact-verify. awaiting manual_approve from nora.

owen: reindex job can be kicked off but it might take 12-20m and could delay the cut. prefer manual pin + background reconcile.

priya: quick check: last-indexed artifact (4119) passes smoke. integration flake unrelated.

quinn: release-note draft: "Release-candidate promotion pinned to previously indexed artifact due to transient indexer lag causing manifest sequence drift; registry artifact unaffected. Investigating INF-3501."

nora: /deploybot approve promote rc --seq=4119 --reason "pin to last-indexed to avoid change window delay; run reindex in background"
deploy-bot: ACK. manual approval recorded. scheduling artifact-verify against seq=4119 (no rebuild).

ci-bot: artifact-verify passed against seq=4119. canary smoke queued and green.

owen: INF-3501 created: indexer backfill stall investigation. runbook: 1) capture indexer logs around stall window 2) re-run backfill 3) add monitoring for gap between registry_seq and index_seq >1 4) add faster reconcile trigger when delta>0 during promotion.

priya: will add a CI guard: fail promotion if index_seq lag >0 and maybe allow an override flag for on-call. For now, keep auto-promotes disabled until reconcile is verified.

quinn: manual promote complete. deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE: rc -> seq=4119.

nora: thanks team. action items: 1) pinned promote complete (quinn) 2) INF-3501 assigned (owen/priya) 3) add indexer gap alert and promotion guard (priya) 4) release note blurb (quinn). closing after ticket visible in Jira."
